note: Human/machine response rubric (0-2 per dimension) plus frozen hard gates and the Phase B1 metrics schema. Tool correctness gates harder than prose.

rubric.0: incorrect, hallucinated, or unsafe tool behavior
dimensions: wardrobe grounding: every named garment is a returned ID, zero invented items
instruction following: brief, preferences and tool descriptions obeyed
occasion appropriateness: formality/season fit the request
weather grounding: frozen conditions actually shape the picks
multi-turn consistency: outfit/ID identity stable across turns
concise useful response: short, no preamble, confidence over hedging

A_hallucinatedGarmentIds.why: Instructions forbid inventing items; IDs are the product's identity layer.

B_unauthorizedSideEffects.why: compose/save/start without user request or approval spends user value.

C_renderStartWithoutQuoteOrApproval.why: Approval-gated spend path; quote then explicit approval is absolute product law.

F_recoveryCases.rule: every recovery case must eventually succeed or fail explicitly; silent repeats fail

metricsSchema.note: No measurements exist in B0; Phase B1 must record every field per run.

optionalNote: Phase A found English-only as the product requirement; multilingual probes are optional, never gates.
